entries.text: [ breathing heavily ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'm not sure... I'm awake.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: You think this is a dream? I mean, you standing here talking to me? All those people out there?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Last night I dreamt tipet was inside my house holding an ax. I thought I woke up this morning. I thought I was awake, but-but then--
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Uh... What do you want me to do, pinch you? You're already awake.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Stedman and leeds must have experienced the same thing... All tipet's victims. Everything seemed real but it was a dream......a dream that ended in their deaths.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Anthony tipet is in a coma, never to regain consciousness.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: He knows me now. He can enter in my dreams.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Listen to me. You've had a tough couple days. You're tired. Go home, get some rest.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ backward-masked record playing in reverse ] she's going to die.
entries.speaker: Anthony Tipet

entries.text: I'm not going to let you do that.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm sorry. I'm not going to kill her. You are.
entries.speaker: Anthony Tipet

entries.text: Agent Doggett?
entries.speaker: Scully’s Voice

entries.text: Agent Doggett. [ whispering ] hi.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: How'd you get here?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Your door was unlocked.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You just saved my life, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I just woke you up, agent Doggett.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Tipet's in my dreams. If you hadn't woken me up just now--
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Anthony tipet is dead. I got the call from Skinner on my way over here. He never regained consciousness.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I seem to be, yes.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, if you need some more time off--
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No. I'm, um... I'm back at work now. That must have been some nightmare you just had.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Tipet thought he'd find god by looking in the darkness inside himself.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: You don't think he succeeded?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: In my dreams, I-- I saw terrible... Violent images. Scared the living daylights out of me. These things are a part of me. I can't deny that, but... Maybe-- maybe they didn't come from me.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Then where'd they come from? It was a bad dream, agent Doggett but that's all it was.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
